title: 加密市场崩盘与FTX破产(2022)
one_line: 2022年加密货币市场崩盘，FTX交易所破产为标志性事件。
overview: The bankruptcy of FTX, a Bahamas-based cryptocurrency exchange, began in November 2022. The collapse of FTX, caused by a spike in customer withdrawals that exposed an $8 billion hole in FTX's accounts, served as the impetus for its bankruptcy. Prior to its collapse, FTX was the third-largest cryptocurrency exchange by volume and had over one million users.（据维基摘要；完整时间线/数据待核实补充。）

创始人 Bankman-Fried 被定罪（细节待核实）
